body: I found one part missing from the compositor effect compared to the shader code. In the shader code the value you assign to `pix_size` is multiplied by `outline_width`, however there is no similar multiplication in the compositor effect. Adding ` pix_size = pix_size * params.outline_width;` into the start of `_get_compute_code` gets us a slightly closer result. There's still a discrepancy with the sky here and some of the shading, but there may be other differences I missed or things to account for with the compositor effects. I would suggest trying to create a minimal shader via both methods and comparing them, then trying to increase complexity gradually in both to try and see, since there is a reasonably large amount of complexity in the current setup which makes it harder to identify where the problem is.
